QF.id: Concept and Role of Mutual Fund_14

question.text: Under SEBI categorization, how many sub-categories are defined for Debt Schemes?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (page 48), Debt Schemes have 16 sub-categories. Pages 50-52 enumerate these sub-categories from Overnight Fund through Floater Fund. The Trap: 10, 12, and 6 are either counts of other broad SEBI scheme categories or fabricated numbers. Note: Per the workbook, the broad SEBI categorization is Equity (11), Debt (16), Hybrid (6), Solution Oriented (2), and Other (2).
